Name: prepare_data.py
Schedule / Trigger: Pi cron — daily 02:00 UTC (every day incl. weekends)
Data Out: Local SQLite warehouse (warehouse.db); DuckDB file (warehouse_duck.db); .cache/ pickle
How to Run / Update: Cron runs automatically. To run manually: python3 prepare_data.py. For DuckDB only: python3 prepare_data.py --materialise-only
Technical Notes: Runs daily including weekends to capture month-end data (current-month file stops updating when the month ends). After materialise, curls /api/warm to rebuild dashboard in-process caches. duckdb CLI must be on PATH (/usr/local/bin). See deploy/pi-crontab for full cron command.

Name: zoho_industry.py
Data Out: Zoho CRM account industry field updates
How to Run / Update: Cron runs automatically. To run manually: python3 zoho_industry.py
Technical Notes: Weekdays only (Mon–Fri). Syncs industry classifications from TryBooking platform data into Zoho CRM. Uses OAuth2 refresh token flow.

Name: zoho_tiers.py
Data Out: Zoho CRM tier field updates; CSV to reports/; retention priority written to SQLite warehouse
How to Run / Update: Cron runs automatically. Manual trigger also available via GitHub Actions zoho_tiers.yml. Dry-run version: zoho_tiers_v2.py
Technical Notes: v2 tier algorithm: 55% current 12m revenue + 35% lifetime revenue + 10% years of loyalty. Percentile bands: T1 top 2%, T2 3–10%, T3 11–25%, T4 26–50%, T5 51–100%. Also writes retention_priority to SQLite — triggers second DuckDB materialise at 03:30 so dashboard is same-day.

Name: s3_to_sharepoint.py
Data Out: SharePoint folder mirror (ETag-based, only changed files)
How to Run / Update: Cron runs automatically. Manual: python3 s3_to_sharepoint.py. Setup mode: --setup. Preview: --dry-run
Technical Notes: ETag-based sync — only uploads files that have changed. Sync manifest persists at /root/s3reporting/.sync_manifest. Requires Azure credentials (AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, AZURE_SENDER_MAILBOX).

Name: backup_to_sharepoint.py
Data Out: SharePoint Backups/pi/YYYY-MM-DD/ folder. Keeps last 7 dated copies
How to Run / Update: Cron runs automatically. Manual: python3 backup_to_sharepoint.py. Skip warehouse: --no-warehouse. Preview: --dry-run
Technical Notes: Runs after the 03:30 re-materialise so backup includes same-day warehouse + retention priority. Protects against SSD failure (single point of failure for data not in git). Restore via restore_from_sharepoint.py.

Name: weekly_reporting_unified.py
Data Out: Email HTML report to stakeholders; CSV to reports/
How to Run / Update: Cron runs automatically. Manual test: export TEST_MODE=1 && python3 weekly_reporting_unified.py. GitHub Actions: reports.yml (workflow_dispatch)
Technical Notes: New account analysis with year-on-year comparisons. TEST_MODE redirects email to test recipients. TEST_DATE overrides processing date. Email sent via Azure Graph API (Mailgun SMTP as fallback). Was previously on GitHub Actions schedule — moved to Pi.

Name: salesiq_weekly.py
Data Out: Email HTML report to stakeholders
How to Run / Update: Cron runs automatically. Manual: python3 salesiq_weekly.py. GitHub Actions: reports.yml (workflow_dispatch)
Technical Notes: Weekly chat summary. Runs 5 minutes before weekly_reporting_unified.py. Requires Zoho credentials. Email via Azure Graph API.

Name: monthly_reporting.py
Schedule / Trigger: GitHub Actions — 1st of each month 09:00 UTC
Data Out: Email HTML report; CSV to reports/
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: monthly_reports.yml (also workflow_dispatch). Manual: python3 monthly_reporting.py
Technical Notes: Monthly performance report for the previous month. Supports debug_mode and show_all_accounts workflow inputs. S3 monthly files land on the 1st; new-month files appear on the 2nd — so the 1st always reads previous month.

Name: sales_commission_report.py
Schedule / Trigger: GitHub Actions — 2nd of each month 09:00 UTC
Data Out: Email PDF + HTML report; CSV to reports/
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: sales_commission.yml (also workflow_dispatch with report_month override). Manual: python3 sales_commission_report.py
Technical Notes: Monthly commission calculation for sales team. Config: sales_commission_config.json (flat fee £15 + percentage per person). Uses email via Azure Graph API.

Name: weekly_domain_report.py
Data Out: CSV email_domains_*.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: weekly_domain_report.yml (also workflow_dispatch). Manual: python3 weekly_domain_report.py
Technical Notes: Extracts and counts email domains from user data. Useful for acquisition channel analysis.

Name: eoy_planning_report.py
Data In: S3: Accounts, BookingData, BookingDataAll; GA4 API
Data Out: Multiple CSVs to planning/, seasonality/, industry/, cohorts/, geography/, keywords/
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: eoy_planning_report.yml. Inputs: report_type (rolling/year_2025/year_2024/custom/monthly_review), custom_start, custom_end, review_month. Manual: python3 eoy_planning_report.py
Technical Notes: Comprehensive monthly metrics for target modelling. Multiple output modes for different planning contexts. Requires GA4 service account credentials.

Name: industry_analysis.py
Data Out: CSVs: industry_analysis_*.csv, industry_period_*.csv, industry_account_*.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: industry_analysis.yml. Manual: python3 industry_analysis.py
Technical Notes: Industry and revenue distribution analysis. Produces account-level, period-level, and summary industry breakdowns.

Name: ppc_reporting.py
Data Out: CSV ppc_report_2024-06-01_YYYY-MM-DD.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: ppc_reporting.yml (test_mode input). Manual: python3 ppc_reporting.py. Config: config/ppc_campaigns.json
Technical Notes: PPC campaign conversion and revenue attribution. Data runs from 2024-06-01 to today. Requires GA4_PROPERTY_ID and GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY. Campaign config in config/ppc_campaigns.json.

Name: regional_segmentation.py
Data Out: CSVs: account_regional_report_*.csv, event_regional_report_*.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: regional_segmentation.yml (debug_mode input). Manual: python3 regional_segmentation.py
Technical Notes: UK regional distribution of accounts and events based on postcodes. Uses modules/uk_regional_segmentation.py.

Name: analyse_wales_ni_sectors.py
Data Out: CSVs: wales_ni*.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: regional_analysis.yml. Manual: python3 analyse_wales_ni_sectors.py
Technical Notes: Industry sector analysis specifically for Wales and Northern Ireland accounts.

Name: keyword_analysis_report.py
Data Out: Multiple CSVs: keyword_analysis_report*.csv, keyword_*/*, *_focused_*.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: keyword_analysis_report.yml (keywords, top_n, industry_filter inputs). Manual: python3 keyword_analysis_report.py
Technical Notes: Event keyword/type frequency analysis (e.g. balls, concerts, musicals). Supports full or focused keyword analysis. Logic in modules/event_keyword_analysis.py.

Name: salesiq_monthly_report.py
Data Out: CSV: salesiq_monthly_YYYY.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: salesiq_monthly_report.yml (year, output_filename inputs). Manual: python3 salesiq_monthly_report.py
Technical Notes: Monthly SalesIQ chat statistics by year. Different from the weekly report — this is for historical/annual analysis.

Name: pricing_scenarios_2026.py
Data Out: CSVs for online, stripe, box_office_card scenarios
How to Run / Update: Manual: python3 pricing_scenarios_2026.py. Config: pricing_scenarios.yml
Technical Notes: 2026 revenue modelling under different fee structures. Three scenario groups defined in pricing_scenarios.yml. One-off planning tool.

Name: pricing_model_comparison.py
Data Out: CSVs to output/pricing_*.csv
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: pricing_comparison.yml (year input). Manual: python3 pricing_model_comparison.py
Technical Notes: Pricing scenario comparison across different models. Use with pricing_scenarios_2026.py for full analysis.

Name: event_completion_reminders.py
Data In: S3: Accounts, BookingData, Users, RiskReport; Vero API
Data Out: Vero user tags; CSV audit trail
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: event_completion_reminders.yml (test_mode, test_date inputs). Manual: python3 event_completion_reminders.py
Technical Notes: Sends behavioural reminders via GetVero after event completion. Tags users in Vero with segmentation data. TEST_MODE skips live Vero writes. API client: modules/utils/vero_api.py.

Name: funds_remaining_reminder.py
Data In: S3: Accounts, Users, RiskReport; Vero API
Data Out: Vero tags (2025-fundsremaining-verified / notverified); CSV
How to Run / Update: GitHub Actions: funds_remaining_reminder.yml (test_mode input). Manual: python3 funds_remaining_reminder.py
Technical Notes: Tags users with remaining funds from past events for re-engagement campaigns. TEST_MODE skips live Vero writes.

Name: check_account_names.py
Data Out: CSV with matched/review/none results
How to Run / Update: python3 check_account_names.py (requires names.txt input file)
Technical Notes: Fuzzy matches a list of account names against S3 data. Useful for cleaning up account lists or identifying duplicates.

Name: zoho_tiers_v2.py
Data Out: CSV: tier_output.csv + summary stats (no Zoho writes)
How to Run / Update: python3 zoho_tiers_v2.py
Technical Notes: Dry-run version of tier calculation — runs the v2 algorithm and outputs results without updating Zoho CRM. Use to preview tier changes before running zoho_tiers.py.

Name: compare_tiers.py
Data Out: Analysis comparison output
How to Run / Update: python3 compare_tiers.py
Technical Notes: Compares tier calculation outputs between methods or runs. Use after zoho_tiers_v2.py to validate changes.

Name: clear_v1_tiers.py
Data Out: Zoho CRM updates (clears old tier data)
How to Run / Update: python3 clear_v1_tiers.py
Technical Notes: One-off utility to clear legacy v1 tier data from Zoho CRM. Only needed for migration/cleanup purposes.

Name: TBUK_Data_Pipeline.py
Data Out: Combined DataFrames in memory
How to Run / Update: Imported as a module; not run directly
Technical Notes: Core ETL pipeline — merges account, balance, risk, and booking data into combined DataFrames. Used as a shared utility by analysis scripts.

Name: generate_dashboard_data.py
Data Out: JSON files (accounts.json, account_metrics.json, ppc_report.json, daily_metrics.json, cohort_curves.json)
How to Run / Update: No longer on cron. Manual: python3 generate_dashboard_data.py (--dry-run, --local-dir options)
Technical Notes: Removed from cron in commit 5490a60. The SvelteKit dashboard now reads the DuckDB warehouse directly — JSON baking is no longer needed. Script retained for reference/manual use only.

Name: box_office_excel/build_workbook.py
Data Out: BoxOfficeTerminals.xlsm (Excel workbook with formulas + VBA hooks)
How to Run / Update: python3 box_office_excel/build_workbook.py (run from repo root). VBA modules in box_office_excel/vba/ must be pasted in manually — see box_office_excel/SETUP.md
Technical Notes: Generates the Box Office Terminals Excel workbook: structured tables, dropdowns, and formula columns. VBA handles business rules (double-booking prevention, trial/payment guard, continuation logic) that worksheet formulas cannot express. One terminal per hire row. No regulated data — safe to run locally.

Name: restore_from_sharepoint.py
Data Out: Local filesystem restore (.env, *.db files)
How to Run / Update: python3 restore_from_sharepoint.py --list (to see available backups). python3 restore_from_sharepoint.py --date YYYY-MM-DD
Technical Notes: Disaster recovery script. Restores Pi state from SharePoint backups created by backup_to_sharepoint.py. Use --list first to see what backups exist.
